entities.name: Louise Blanchard Bethune
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Louise Blanchard Bethune was the first American woman known to have worked as a professional architect. She was born in Waterloo, New York. Blanchard worked primarily in Buffalo, New York with her husband at Bethune, Bethune & Fuchs.
